title: ops-story-health-monitor / critic — output schema
description: The Output schema of the tool-less `critic` AI Agent action (fast model, runs only for high/critical findings). It may only confirm or lower the triage severity. This file is an addition to the ../DESIGN.md §2.2 tree (the design names one output-schema.json); the critic needs its own schema because Triggers branch on `agrees`.

agrees.description: true when the cited evidence supports the triage severity. false forces needs_human in the verdict transform.

severity.description: The severity the evidence supports. The verdict transform takes the LOWER of triage.severity and this value; the critic can never raise a severity.

reason.description: One sentence naming the decisive evidence rows.

missing_evidence.description: The evidence that would settle it, or an empty string.
